name: Checkout blocks completion without required payment proof
description: Verify the checkout UI cannot reach Ringkasan when payment proof or transfer confirmation is missing.

planSteps.description: Clear cookies and local storage. Add exactly one Classic Ceramic Mug to the cart, sign in as rafi.ahmad@example.com with password RafStore#2026, and open /checkout.
Fill valid shipping details with recipient TestSprite Required Proof Negative 2026, continue through Pembayaran, and arrive at checkout step 3 Konfirmasi.
Verify Bukti pembayaran is visibly marked Wajib and states Wajib diunggah untuk menyelesaikan checkout.
Verify Unggah bukti & selesaikan checkout is disabled with no file selected, no general Lanjutkan button exists on step 3, and the Ringkasan step cannot be opened.
Verify the page remains on Konfirmasi and explains Ringkasan terbuka setelah bukti pembayaran berhasil diunggah.
